on the little debugging that i did, i saw that this only happens on the first frame of the program, as if it tries to render before the pipeline is set up, so the first frame is "skipped" in a way

Started tracing:
* MainOpaquePass3dNode runs BinnedRenderPhase<Opaque3d>::render()
* Which calls render_batchable_meshes()
* Which calls RenderCommandState::draw()
* Which uses the DrawMaterial render command
* Which uses the SetMeshViewBindGroup render command
* Which reads ViewLightsUniformOffset as part of the ViewQuery

For some reason ViewLightsUniformOffset is missing from the view entity, hence why it's throwing InvalidViewQuery. 

ViewLightsUniformOffset should've been added to the view entity as part of prepare_lights().
